rules.description: Verifies that the percentage of deleted records does not exceed the 0.1% threshold, ensuring unintended observation drops (such as missing nonpoint sources which drop >20% of records) are caught while accommodating minor upstream EPA revisions.
Verifies that the dataset's observation dates meet freshness and temporal coverage requirements (MAX(MaxDate) >= 2020 and MIN(MaxDate) >= 2008)

params.query: SELECT MAX(MaxDate) AS max_date, MIN(MaxDate) AS min_date FROM stats
